title: A Hymn of Glory Let Us Sing
alsoKnownAs: Sing We Triumphant Hymns of Praise
description: A Hymn of Glory Let Us Sing in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 8 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by The Venerable Bede, first published in 735. The English translation is by Benjamin Webb and Elizabeth Rundle Charles (1858). The tune, LASST UNS ERFREUEN, is from Geistliche Kirchengesäng, Köln, 1623. This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: A hymn of glo-ry let us sing! New hymns through-out the world shall ring: A-lle-lu-ia! A-lle-lu-ia! Christ by a way none e-ver trod, A-scends un-to the throne of God. A-lle-lu-ia! A-lle-lu-ia! A-lle-lu-ia! A-lle-lu-ia! A-lle-lu-ia!

lines: A hymn of glory let us sing!
New hymns throughout the world shall ring:
Christ by a way none ever trod,
Ascends unto the throne of God.
The angels say to the elev'n,
This is the Savior This is He!
Again shall ye behold Him so
As ye today have seen Him go;
Calm soaring through the radiant sky,
May our affections there do tend,
Toward Thy kingdom's throne where Thou
As in our faith are seated now.
Be Thou our present joy O Lord!
Who will be ever our reward,
And, as the countless ages flee,
May all our glory be in Thee!
D O risen Christ ascended Lord.
All praise to Thee let earth accord,
Who are while endless ages run,
With Father and with Spirit One.  Alleluia!
